Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator incorrectly assumed that the PDB file located at the specified local path (`/Users/icyfeather/Projects/Magentic-One/gaia-val/...`) contained the data for PDB ID 5wb7. The task explicitly required parsing the PDB file of protein 5wb7 from the RCSB Protein Data Bank. By relying on a pre-verified fact about a local file path without verifying its actual content or ensuring it matched the requested PDB ID, the Orchestrator set the entire conversation on a false premise. This led to the FileSurfer agent searching for "ATOM" entries in a file that likely did not contain the correct data, resulting in the extraction of incorrect coordinates (GLU A) instead of the correct ones for 5wb7. This error mirrors the pattern in Example 1 and Example 6 where agents make unverified assumptions about data structure or source content, leading to downstream failures.
